questions.question: A cell of e.m.f. E and internal resistance r is connected across a variable resistor R. What is the condition for maximum power dissipation in R, and what is the maximum power dissipated?

Two uniform wires X and Y of the same material have lengths in the ratio 2:3 and radii in the ratio 1:2. If they are connected in parallel across a constant potential difference, calculate the ratio of current flowing through X to that through Y.

In a balanced Wheatstone bridge, the four arms have resistances R₁ = 10 Ω, R₂ = 20 Ω, R₃ = 30 Ω, and R₄ = 60 Ω. If a 12 V battery with negligible internal resistance is connected across the bridge input, calculate the current drawn from the battery.

A parallel-plate capacitor with air dielectric has capacitance C. If the separation between the plates is doubled and a dielectric slab of dielectric constant κ = 6 is inserted to completely fill the space, what is the new capacitance?
A 100 Ω resistor, a 0.5 H inductor, and a 10 μF capacitor are connected in series to an A.C. source given by V = 200√2 sin(100t) V. Calculate the peak current flowing through the circuit.

A copper wire carries a current of 5.0 A. If the charge density of free electrons in copper is 8.5 × 10²⁸ m⁻³ and the cross-sectional area of the wire is 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ m², calculate the drift velocity of the electrons. (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)
Three identical capacitors each of capacitance 6 μF are connected such that two are in parallel and the combination is in series with the third. What is the effective capacitance of the arrangement?

A circular loop of radius 0.1 m and resistance 2.0 Ω is placed perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field. The magnetic field decreases at a steady rate of 0.5 T s⁻¹. Determine the induced current in the loop.
A square conducting coil of side 20 cm having 50 turns is rotated at 300 r.p.m. about an axis perpendicular to a magnetic field of 0.1 T. Calculate the maximum e.m.f. induced in the coil.
An ideal step-down transformer transforms 2200 V to 220 V. If the primary winding has 2000 turns and the output power is 4.4 kW, calculate the primary current.

A metal rod of length 0.5 m rotates in a horizontal plane about one of its ends with an angular speed of 40 rad s⁻¹ in a vertical magnetic field of 0.2 T. What is the induced e.m.f. between the center and the end of the rod?
When the current in a coil changes uniformly from 10 A to 2 A in 0.1 s, an e.m.f. of 16 V is induced in a neighboring coil. What is the mutual inductance between the two coils?
The energy stored in a 0.2 H inductor carrying a steady current of 5 A is equal to:

A projectile is launched from ground level with an initial velocity u at an angle θ above the horizontal. If its maximum height reached equals its horizontal range, what is the angle of projection θ?

A body of mass 2 kg is projected from the ground with velocity 20 m s⁻¹ at an angle of 30° to the horizontal. Calculate the kinetic energy of the body at the highest point of its trajectory. (g = 10 m s⁻²)
A particle moves along a straight line such that its displacement x at time t is given by x = 2t³ − 9t² + 12t − 4. At what time t is the acceleration of the particle zero?

A block of mass 5 kg slides down a rough plane inclined at 30° to the horizontal with a uniform acceleration of 1.0 m s⁻². Taking g = 10 m s⁻², calculate the coefficient of kinetic friction between the block and the plane.

A shell of mass 10 kg moving horizontally at 100 m s⁻¹ explodes into two equal fragments. If one fragment continues to move forward along the original direction at 160 m s⁻¹, calculate the velocity of the second fragment.

questions.question: A flywheel of moment of inertia 4.0 kg m² accelerates uniformly from rest to an angular speed of 30 rad s⁻¹ in 6.0 s. What is the net torque exerted on the flywheel during this interval?
A satellite of mass m orbits the Earth at an altitude equal to the Earth's radius R_E. If g is the acceleration due to gravity on the Earth's surface, what is the orbital speed of the satellite?

Two masses m₁ = 3 kg and m₂ = 2 kg are connected over a smooth light pulley by a light inextensible string in an Atwood machine. Taking g = 10 m s⁻², calculate the tension in the string during motion.
A progressive transverse wave is represented by y = 0.05 sin(200πt − 0.5πx), where x and y are in meters and t is in seconds. What is the speed of propagation of the wave?

A sound source moves toward a stationary observer at a speed equal to one-fifth the speed of sound in air. What is the ratio of the frequency heard by the observer to the true frequency of the source?

In Young's double-slit experiment, monochromatic light of wavelength 600 nm falls on slits separated by 0.2 mm. If the interference fringes are observed on a screen 1.5 m away, calculate the fringe width.
A convex lens of focal length 15 cm forms a real image three times the size of the object. How far is the object positioned from the lens?
A glass prism of refracting angle 60° produces a minimum deviation of 30°. Calculate the refractive index of the glass material.

Unpolarized light passes through two ideal polaroids placed in sequence. If the transmission axis of the second polaroid is inclined at 30° to that of the first, what fraction of the incident unpolarized light intensity is transmitted through the pair?
An open organ pipe of length 0.8 m produces a fundamental frequency f. If one end of the pipe is closed, what will be the new fundamental frequency of the closed pipe?

A astronomical telescope has an objective lens of focal length 100 cm and an eyepiece of focal length 4 cm. What is the total length of the telescope tube in normal adjustment, and its magnifying power?
